description: Defines an abstract generic base class for converting between entity objects and Data Transfer Objects (DTOs). Provides common collection-based conversion methods, acting as a utility base for specific mapper implementations.

classes.name: BaseMapper
classes.description: An abstract generic class providing a contract and common collection conversion methods for mapping between entity and DTO objects.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a DTO to an Entity. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: convertToDto
methods.description: Abstract method to convert an Entity to a DTO. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Converts a collection of DTOs to Entities using the abstract convertToEntity method.

methods.name: convertToDto
methods.description: Converts a collection of Entities to DTOs using the abstract convertToDto method.

methods.name: convertToEntityList
methods.description: Converts a collection of DTOs to a List of Entities.

methods.name: convertToDtoList
methods.description: Converts a collection of Entities to a List of DTOs.

methods.name: convertToEntitySet
methods.description: Converts a collection of DTOs to a Set of Entities.

methods.name: convertToDtoSet
methods.description: Converts a collection of Entities to a Set of DTOs.
